_comment: GOVERNED, NON-LOADED EXAMPLE — engine-runtime/04 (NFR-005, Tier-2). This file is a reference only.
ASP.NET Core auto-loads ONLY appsettings.json + appsettings.{ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT}.json, so this
file is NEVER loaded by the host or CI (the committed default in appsettings.json stays Provider=Fake
— CI has no governed endpoint and never egresses). To activate the live provider in a governed
deployment, the orchestrator supplies these Generation:* values as env vars (Generation__Provider,
Generation__Endpoint, ...) sourced VERBATIM from the infrastructure/modules/ai.bicep outputs — see
the mapping table in docs/features/engine-runtime/PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md. ClaudeFoundry is the
quality-preferred alternative (same keys, Provider=ClaudeFoundry, Endpoint=ai.bicep claudeEndpoint).
Auth is keyless (DefaultAzureCredential) — no API key is ever stored here or anywhere.
KEY SHAPE ONLY — the per-model token prices the staff AI-usage cost view reads
(GET /api/engine/usage, engine-telemetry-tuning story 03a). Bound to EngineUsagePricingOptions,
a SEPARATE options class from GenerationOptions (which the NFR-005 startup governance gate above
validates); pricing is deliberately not part of that gate, so a missing or wrong price can never
block a governed provider from starting.
READ THIS BEFORE FILING A BUG: with no entry for the model an engine.generated event records, the
panel shows that model's token counts with an explicit 'unpriced' state and NO dollar figure. That
is CORRECT behaviour, not a defect — it is what stops a missing price from rendering as a $0 that
reads as 'this was free'. The panel reads $0 for the Fake provider for a different and equally
correct reason: Fake performs no egress and reports 0 tokens by construction.
The model key MUST match the model id the event records — i.e. the Tiers.*.Model values above
(gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.4-mini), not the deployment name. Lookup is case-insensitive on both provider and
model. Rates are per 1,000,000 tokens, and the four categories price separately.
Rates are NOT committed anywhere in this repo, here included: Foundry deployments use
versionUpgradeOption 'OnceNewDefaultVersionAvailable' (infrastructure/modules/ai.bicep), so they
are not version-pinned and a committed figure would silently go stale under the deployment. Supply
the real figures per environment as app settings, from the provider's published price list:
Generation__Pricing__Currency=USD
Generation__Pricing__Providers__AzureOpenAI__gpt-5.4__InputPer1MTokens=<rate>
Generation__Pricing__Providers__AzureOpenAI__gpt-5.4__OutputPer1MTokens=<rate>
Generation__Pricing__Providers__AzureOpenAI__gpt-5.4__CacheReadPer1MTokens=<rate>
Generation__Pricing__Providers__AzureOpenAI__gpt-5.4__CacheCreationPer1MTokens=<rate>
The placeholders below are strings ON PURPOSE. They will not bind to a decimal, so copying this
block without editing it fails loudly instead of pricing a live model at $0 — the one outcome this
whole section exists to prevent. Replace every placeholder, or omit the entry entirely and accept
the honest 'unpriced' state.
